about: The shared-brain access run on gbrain v0.60.761.0: per-cell exposure, answers, refused reads and cost, and the preregistered paired comparisons for the refusal, the labelled company brain with per-person keys, per-person keys alone and the installer and told routes, from the stored evidence of every scored trial.
